blocks.en: Let $(\mathcal{D}(L),L)$ be defined by \eqref{eq:sturm-liouville-weighted-differential-operator} and \eqref{eq:sturm-liouville-unmixed-operator-domain}. The following hold:\begin{enumerate}\item The eigenvalues of $(\mathcal{D}(L),L)$ are real.\item The eigenvalues of $(\mathcal{D}(L),L)$ are bounded below by a constant $\lambda_G\in\mathbb{R}$.\item Eigenfunctions corresponding to distinct eigenvalues are mutually orthogonal in $L_w^2(a,b)$.\item Each eigenvalue has multiplicity one.\end{enumerate}
blocks.zh: 设 $(\mathcal{D}(L),L)$ 由 \eqref{eq:sturm-liouville-weighted-differential-operator} 和 \eqref{eq:sturm-liouville-unmixed-operator-domain} 定义. 以下结论成立:\begin{enumerate}\item $(\mathcal{D}(L),L)$ 的特征值为实数.\item $(\mathcal{D}(L),L)$ 的特征值以某个常数 $\lambda_G\in\mathbb{R}$ 为下界.\item 不同特征值所对应的特征函数在 $L_w^2(a,b)$ 中相互正交.\item 每个特征值的重数均为一.\end{enumerate}
blocks.label: thm:regular-sturm-liouville-first-spectral-properties
